to each other in some way.
We will categorize data into ﬁve types and describe each in turn:
data associated with a measurement of some quantity on an observational unit,
data associated with some quality or property of an observational unit,
data which represent true or false and play an important role later,
data which should be there but are not, and

Qualitative Data, Categorical Data, and Factors
Qualitative data are simply any type of data that are not numerical, or do not represent numerical quantities.
Examples of qualitative variables include a subject’s name,
nomic status, class rank, driver’s license number, and social security number (SSN).
